rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for going beyond an acceptable limit, boundary, or convention.

example.english: Asking someone about private matters like that really does overstep the mark.
example.traditional: 你咁樣問人私人嘢，真係過界喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 man6 jan4 si1 jan4 je5 zan1 hai6 gwo3 gaai3 wo3

rows.note: Use this only when a foot or step lands too far forward, not for crossing a social boundary.

example.english: On the stairs, if your foot goes too far forward, you can overstep the edge and miss a step.
example.traditional: 你行樓梯嗰陣隻腳踏得太前，差啲踩空。
example.jyutping: nei5 haang4 lau4 tai1 go2 zan6 zek3 goek3 daap6 dak1 taai3 cin4 caa1 di1 caai2 hung1
